title: Barta Theorem for the $p$-Laplacian and Geometric Applications
summary: In this article, we develop a Barta-type formulation for the $p$-Laplacian on Riemannian manifolds, extending the approach of Cheung-Leung and Bessa-Montenegro from the linear to the nonlinear setting. This framework yields sharp lower bounds for the $p$-fundamental tone without any assumptions on boundary regularity. As applications, we obtain nonlinear extensions of Cheng's eigenvalue comparison theorem and the Cheng-Li-Yau estimate for $p \geq 2$ in the context of minimal immersions.
